chronicle.text: Reloulour tied fiber and fiber together with fiber and was left with something to carry things in: the first carrier.
Vaisumun tied a bundle they had tied and wood together with fiber and was left with something that floats and carries someone across water: the first raft.
Gebaiten tied stone and wood together with fiber and was left with something heavy on a handle: the first club.
Gebaiten struck flint with stone and was left with a sharp edge: the first blade.
3 people now tell that wolves mauled Vaisumun. It was a bear. The story changed as it was passed on.
Shebei tied a carrier and a blade together with fiber and was left with a sharp point on a long shaft: the first spear.
3 people now take the mark <-|/> to go with food set down, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
Deroul tied a carrier and a carrier together with fiber and was left with something warm to wear: the first wrap.
4 people now take the mark <.|-> to go with stone being struck, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
